<article title="Order tracking">
You can follow your order from the Orders page of your account. Once a package leaves our warehouse, the order shows a carrier name and a tracking number, and the carrier's page updates within 24 hours of the first scan.

If the tracking page has not updated for more than three business days, the package may be delayed at a carrier hub. In that case we can open a trace with the carrier; a trace usually resolves within five business days.

Orders placed before 2 pm on a business day leave the warehouse the same day. Orders placed later, or on weekends, leave the next business day.

</article>

Customer first name: Oluwaseun
<request>
shipped but no tracking
the order says shipped two days ago but there is no tracking number anywhere.
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Oluwaseun,

Thanks for reaching out. Once a package leaves our warehouse, the tracking number and carrier name appear on the Orders page of your account. Because your order shows as shipped, you can check there again for the carrier and tracking number.

Please note that after a package ships, the carrier's tracking page can take up to 24 hours from the first scan to update. If the tracking page still hasn't updated after three business days, let us know and we can open a trace with the carrier.

If you still can't find a tracking number on your Orders page, a support specialist will follow up with you.

Fernwood Outfitters Support
